title: Flood Response
description: Why a few inches of moving water can knock you down and a foot can carry away a car, and what to do if trapped in a building or vehicle. Covers flood alerts, evacuation, floodwater contamination and wound care, water and food safety, and safe cleanup.
shortDescription: Turn Around Don't Drown, rising water, trapped cars, and contaminated floodwater
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
